sourceFile: 45.BRS-161014 Report test Frame improvement cavity A, B, C_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The source appears comparable, but the draft has blocking changed-factor and outcome extraction errors.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly includes TOTAL and unordered frame types.
Subgroup keys omit required type/cavity and date or round context.
Height measurements include row indexes, headers, and synthetic Column/MAX stats.
Function results mix likely separate groups without preserving row-level context.
Several outcomes are duplicated or mislabeled as measurements.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal versus improved Frame A/B/C.
Remove TOTAL unless source proves it is a real condition.
Regroup outcomes into height dimension and function NG results under the same frame-change context.
Rebuild subresults only from valid data rows with type/cavity and date/round preserved.
Drop header/index-derived and zero-only synthetic measurement stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are not sufficient until grouping and valid data-row citations are corrected.
